svg.aria-label: The same reading at three levels, from broadest to finest: time spent against the target line, with the gap highlighted. Contract: the overall picture, a single bar. Group: classes or teams falling behind, a few bars. Learner: who has reached their target, one bar per person, with a dot at the end of those that reach it.
